name: garou_settei
compression: none (raw NGPC 2bpp tiles, 16 bytes per 8x8 tile)

map.entry: one byte per cell = tile index into the tile block; the palette is chosen by the game code (palette 0 on p1 here)
map.loader: object command at 0xD3210: [op16][map16][01 00][tile ptr 24][00][count16]; the tile block of command k uses the map field of command k+1 (map = 0xD0000 + map16)

cells_format: [tile, palette, hflip, vflip] row by row

png_index_map.note: transparent (colour 0 of every palette); shown as the screen backdrop colour

max_size.note: Stay inside the 32x16 px area. The tile block holds 8 tiles; tiles listed in shared_with_rest_of_screen are also used outside this area and must not change (or the map must be repointed to free tiles).
